_comment: Form definitions + provider wiring. Replaced the Tally iframes. Chose MailerLite over Resend because this is a static site with no server: MailerLite's form endpoint is designed to take a browser POST with no secret, while a Resend API key can never reach the browser and would need a serverless function hosted somewhere other than GitHub Pages. See CLAUDE.md.
consent: Piekrītu, ka SIA “Stonks” (Mārketinga Skola) apstrādā manis norādītās ziņas, lai sazinātos par šo pieteikumu, saskaņā ar privātuma politiku. Piekrišanu var atsaukt jebkurā brīdī, rakstot uz rihards@marketingaskola.lv.
